title: Thinking on Accepted Truths, Defaults and How We Got Here
summary: Kahran and Divya close season three by digging into the things cultures take as given that aren't actually given — including the engineer's default of grabbing more market share at all costs. They detour through audience segmentation, the difference between instrumental and communicative design (corporate rainbow-checkboxing vs. queer self-expression), and how feedback from non-listeners reshapes what they make.
topics: the obligation of asking the question
